import numpy as np

# NASA outlays FY 2008-2017 (in millions)
data = [17834, 19168, 18906, 17617, 17190, 16978, 17093, 18272, 18828, 18698]

print("Original data (millions):", data)
print("Sorted:", sorted(data))

# 10% Winsorization with n=10: replace 1 lowest and 1 highest
# Replace minimum with 2nd smallest value
# Replace maximum with 2nd largest value

sorted_data = sorted(data)
winsorized = data.copy()

# Find indices of min and max
min_idx = data.index(min(data))
max_idx = data.index(max(data))

# 10% winsorization: replace min with 2nd smallest, max with 2nd largest
second_smallest = sorted_data[1]
second_largest = sorted_data[-2]

winsorized = [second_smallest if x == min(data) else second_largest if x == max(data) else x for x in data]

print(f"\n10% Winsorization (n={len(data)}):")
print(f"  Original min: {min(data)}, Original max: {max(data)}")
print(f"  Replace min with: {second_smallest}, Replace max with: {second_largest}")
print(f"  Winsorized data: {winsorized}")
print(f"  Winsorized min: {min(winsorized)}, Winsorized max: {max(winsorized)}")

winsorized_range = max(winsorized) - min(winsorized)
print(f"\n10% Winsorized range: {winsorized_range} million = {winsorized_range/1000:.2f} billion dollars")
EOF
